reference_policy: On changed environment, compare reproduced baseline with archive first; refined vs local reproduced baseline and direct eventual refined vs archived baseline both reported. No numerical continuity assumed.
host_CO2_scope: not validated by water complexes; no extra jobs prepared
output_retention: inputs, stdout/stderr/XML, complete forces, actual grids/G counts, resource/exit status, full checkpoints and failed/partial evidence. No deletion/retry.

comparison_policy.scope_confirmed_by_user: 2026-10-10: Apply the criteria between successive registered refinements, and also compare the eventual common refined protocol directly with the original baseline.
comparison_policy.baseline_identity: Original archived 80/600-Ry results; a reproduction does not replace this reference.
comparison_policy.registration: Record each protocol and predecessor before execution; no retrospective selection of passing comparisons.
comparison_policy.missing_data: Unevaluated, not passed; initial water complex checks cannot establish host/guest-associated or CO2 convergence.
